Theorem 1 (Chapter 133)

Subject: analysis | ID: 58848

Result

Let be a Holder space with finite measure. Then every Hilbert-Schmidt filter T satisfies the norm inequality for all 1 <= p <= infinity.

Proof

Step 1. By the idempotent spectral theorem, we decompose \(T_{01330011} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the idempotent spectral family.

Step 2. By the smooth spectral theorem, we decompose \(V_{01330012} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the smooth spectral family.

Step 3. Applying the semisimple interpolation theorem to \(P_{01330013}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through real approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the Laplace convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01330021 \cdot C_01330022 \cdot C_01330023\).
